title: Kael Drakkel — The Ashen Compact
summary: Curated level-50 Shadow Knight expedition · Live testing.
body:
Enter through the Keeper in the hidden Everfrost passage before Permafrost. Level-50 characters can use its Raid and Grind runs. To earn the story helmet, hold Shadow Knight and accept the Compact with Drazhul before starting your run. Stock Velious enemies, drops and exits are excluded from this private campaign.

Rewards

  • Cinder of the Ashen Compact · Augment
  • Cinder of the Ashen Compact (Polished) · Augment
  • Cinder of the Ashen Compact (Exalted) · Augment
  • Cinder of the Ashen Compact (Ascension) · Augment
  • Iron Oath Gorget · Miniboss relic
  • Kharzug's War Mantle · Miniboss relic
  • Vhalek's Soulcleaver · Miniboss relic
  • Warhelm of the Ashen Compact · Quest helmet
  • Polished Blade of the Ashen Compact · Final Raid reward
  • Ascended Blade of the Ashen Compact · Final Raid reward
  • Polished Mantle of the Iron Oath · Final Raid reward
  • Ascended Mantle of the Iron Oath · Final Raid reward
  • Polished Seal of Commanded Souls · Final Raid reward
  • Ascended Seal of Commanded Souls · Final Raid reward

Temporary encounter actors yield no loot or XP. Cinder augments follow the existing type-22 forging recipe; other equipment does not. Full encounter and appearance acceptance remain pending.
